about.leadBefore: Curious about the structures behind how people
about.copy: I am currently a student majoring in supply chain and logistics. I believe my interests in interactive media arts could help shape a better understanding of what I learn. I am drawn to both the operational logic of complex systems and the expressive possibilities of interactive media.
